IRS990.Desc: Space 4 Art serves as a diverse affordable creative incubator inclusive cultural venue and community based arts-education center via 1 23 affordable spaces in which 35+ artists live work teach collaborate and share their work with the community through educational outreach and cultural events 2 free project-based STEM- and healing-based arts programming for students in schools and organizations in under-resourced neighborhoods and 3 free to low-cost arts and cultural events for the public at large.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Prepared form is shared with Finance Committee which is comprised of some members of the Board including Treasurer and President and key staff members. After their review it is shared with entire Board and then signed by President before e-filing with IRS.

The Board of Directors used national & local survey data for comparable positions with organizations having similar gross receipts. Compensation reviewed and voted on by the Board as part of budgeting process. Annual performance evaluation of ED by Board and other staff members by ED.
Form 990 is available on own website other websites like Guidestar Charity Navigator and a copy is filed in the office for review upon request.
